name: Omnara
description: Supervises managed coding agents from a single control plane across terminal, web, and mobile, letting you monitor and steer long-running runs remotely.

skills.name: Agent Monitoring
skills.description: Streams the live state of running coding agents including current step and pending questions.

skills.name: Remote Steering
skills.description: Sends instructions or answers to a running agent from web or mobile without a terminal.

skills.name: Session History
skills.description: Stores past agent sessions with their prompts, tool calls, and outcomes for later review.
